ctx.x: Yeah, I think we’ve pretty much covered that.

I want to take a left turn. We’ve talked about all of the hats that you’ve worn throughout your life. I want to talk about the hat that you wear as a family man, as a husband, and as a father, because you have two sons who have followed in your footsteps, and I know your relationship with your wife was a longstanding one. If you want to get a little personal, but certainly how George and Ed have been carrying on, and your feelings about them.

As for my wife, we met in Cincinnati when I was in the orchestra and therefore teaching at the conservatory there. I taught horn. She was – we were both 17. She was a student and a double major, piano and voice. I was on the faculty. We got together, and we were together 50 years. We first lived in New York, until I came to the Conservatory.
